core_requirements: Always use filtered matrix when available; use raw only if filtered is absent.
Use matrix/ as expected sample manifest and suppl/ as data source.
Validate gene names and barcodes; reject suspicious loads (e.g., mostly numeric genes).
Exclude non-coding RNAs at the earliest feasible stage.
If IDs are not gene symbols (e.g., ENSG), map to gene symbols before integration.
Do not require one-batch completion; pipeline must be resumable and GSE-by-GSE.
Use up to 80 CPUs and 500GB RAM as needed.
Integrate TCR only after all 26 GSE scRNA-seq are completed and merged.
Minimize script proliferation: revise existing scripts by default; create a new version only when context/workflow is materially different and document why.

stages.name: Stage 0 - Project setup
actions: Create analysis_26GSE_V4 directory structure.
Initialize run manifest, config, and logging templates.
Capture software versions and runtime limits.

stages.name: Stage 1 - Discovery per GSE
actions: Parse matrix/*.series_matrix.txt.gz for sample expectations.
Enumerate all candidate files in suppl/ and extracted_* dirs.
Build per-GSE file inventory (H5/MTX/TSV/H5AD/tar).

stages.name: Stage 2 - Load per GSE
actions: Apply priority: filtered H5/MTX > filtered alternatives > raw matrices.
Load samples with strict de-duplication based on canonical sample IDs.
For raw matrices, apply stricter QC before acceptance.
Special handling: GSE161918 RNA only (exclude CSP/protein channel).

stages.name: Stage 3 - Early feature normalization
actions: Standardize feature names to gene symbols.
Translate ENSG/other IDs to gene symbols using mapping table(s).
Resolve duplicates after mapping (stable deterministic aggregation rule).
Remove non-coding RNAs before downstream integration.

stages.name: Stage 4 - Per-GSE QC and save
actions: Run cell/gene QC thresholds and mitochondrial filtering.
Save cleaned per-GSE AnnData and QC metrics.
Record expected-vs-loaded sample reconciliation.

stages.name: Stage 5 - Cross-GSE merge
actions: Merge successful GSE objects with consistent gene symbol space.
Prefer integration-safe feature intersection policy where required.
Save integrated scRNA object and metadata manifests.

stages.name: Stage 6 - TCR integration
actions: Use completed TCR tables after scRNA integration is finalized.
Attach TCR features via sample/barcode mapping workflow.
Produce final scRNA+TCR integrated outputs and coverage summary.

rejection_rules: Missing companion files for MTX and cannot reconstruct.
Feature/cell dimensions implausible after reasonable parsing.
Predominantly numeric/invalid gene names without recoverable mapping.

content_checks: cell and gene count ranges per sample and per GSE

ncRNA_filtering.rule: remove known non-coding RNA patterns before integration
ncRNA_filtering.audit: record removed feature count per GSE

attention_points: Avoid silent failures: never swallow exceptions without logging file path + reason.
Do not double-load the same sample from multiple extracted directories.
Do not use nCount_RNA-dependent logic; use total_counts/n_genes_by_counts style metrics.
Handle GSE-specific naming idiosyncrasies for MTX components.
Ensure filtered-vs-raw choice is explicit and recorded per sample.
Keep TCR pipeline outputs untouched until scRNA integration is complete.
Maintain resumability: each GSE should be independently restartable.
Minimize script proliferation: revise existing scripts by default; create a new version only when context/workflow is materially different and document why.

guardrails: I/O-aware scheduling to avoid extraction storms
bounded workers per heavy matrix load

deliverables: Comprehensive final report with unresolved blockers (if any)

success: All 26 GSEs loaded or explicitly documented as truly problematic with evidence.
Integrated scRNA object built from all valid GSEs.
TCR data added after scRNA integration.
Final report includes full traceability and QC summaries.
